items.title: Qdrant 1.20 - Full-Text Search Improvements
items.summary: Qdrant 1.20.0 is out! Let’s look at the main features for this version:BM25 on Full-Text Indexes and Code Search: Rank by BM25 straight from your payload text, with no embeddings to generate. Plus, better code search with a new code tokenizer.Faster Nested Filters: A new per-element payload index answers nested filters without reading payloads, making them faster.16-Bit and 8-Bit TurboQuant: A 16-bit TurboQuant datatype that halves vector storage without accuracy loss, and an 8-bit TurboQuant datatype and quantization option with recall close to float16.
items.creator: info@qdrant.tech (Andrey Vasnetsov)
